SPIREDUO-EUCALYPTUS_LEAF.title: Eucalyptus Leaf
SPIREDUO-EUCALYPTUS_LEAF.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{DrowsyPower}[/blue] [gold]Drowsy[/gold].
SPIREDUO-EUCALYPTUS_LEAF.flavor: Koalas sleep up to twenty hours a day. This is why.
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_BASKET.title: Bamboo Basket
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_BASKET.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{BambooPower}[/blue] [gold]Bamboo[/gold].
SPIREDUO-COUPLE_RINGS.title: Couple Rings
SPIREDUO-COUPLE_RINGS.description: At the start of each combat, every player gains [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIREDUO-COUPLE_RINGS.flavor: One for you, one for me.
SPIREDUO-SPARE_KEY.title: Spare Key
SPIREDUO-SPARE_KEY.description: Whenever you heal at a Rest Site, every other player heals [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
SPIREDUO-SPARE_KEY.flavor: Come in, the door's always open.
SPIREDUO-FLUFFY_PILLOW.title: Fluffy Pillow
SPIREDUO-FLUFFY_PILLOW.description: At the end of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] for each card you [gold]Retain[/gold].
SPIREDUO-ALARM_CLOCK.title: Alarm Clock
SPIREDUO-ALARM_CLOCK.description: Whenever you remove all your [gold]Drowsy[/gold], draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards.
SPIREDUO-ALARM_CLOCK.flavor: It rings every morning. Nobody gets up.
SPIREDUO-NIGHT_CAP.title: Night Cap
SPIREDUO-NIGHT_CAP.description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{DrowsyPower}[/blue] [gold]Drowsy[/gold].
SPIREDUO-NIGHT_CAP.flavor: Fashion is optional. Sleep is not.
SPIREDUO-BODY_PILLOW.title: Body Pillow
SPIREDUO-BODY_PILLOW.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Drowsy[/gold], gain that much [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIREDUO-BODY_PILLOW.flavor: Hug it tight and drift off.
SPIREDUO-CHOPSTICKS.title: Chopsticks
SPIREDUO-CHOPSTICKS.description: Whenever you can't pay for a [gold]Munch[/gold], gain [blue]{BambooPower}[/blue] [gold]Bamboo[/gold].
SPIREDUO-RICE_BOWL.title: Rice Bowl
SPIREDUO-RICE_BOWL.description: At the end of your turn, if you have [blue]{Threshold}[/blue] or more [gold]Bamboo[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIREDUO-GOLDEN_BAMBOO.title: Golden Bamboo
SPIREDUO-GOLDEN_BAMBOO.description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{BambooPower}[/blue] [gold]Bamboo[/gold].
SPIREDUO-GOLDEN_BAMBOO.flavor: Too pretty to eat. Eaten anyway.
SPIREDUO-LUNCH_BOX.title: Lunch Box
SPIREDUO-LUNCH_BOX.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{BambooPower}[/blue] [gold]Bamboo[/gold].
SPIREDUO-EUCALYPTUS_CROWN.title: Eucalyptus Crown
SPIREDUO-EUCALYPTUS_CROWN.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{DrowsyPower}[/blue] [gold]Drowsy[/gold].
SPIREDUO-EUCALYPTUS_CROWN.flavor: Heavy is the head that naps.
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_HAMPER.title: Bamboo Hamper
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_HAMPER.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{BambooPower}[/blue] [gold]Bamboo[/gold].
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_HAMPER.flavor: Packed for two. Empty by noon.
